rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – notice of tenants' rights at eviction/non-renewal
rules.requirement: A landlord who serves a Notice to Quit or decides not to renew a lease must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time, and send a copy of the notice with a Certificate of Compliance/Service to the Office of Housing Stability. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.requirement_es: El arrendador que entregue un aviso de desalojo (Notice to Quit) o decida no renovar el contrato debe entregar al inquilino al mismo tiempo un Aviso de Derechos y Recursos del Inquilino, y enviar una copia con un Certificado de Cumplimiento/Entrega a la Oficina de Estabilidad de Vivienda. Una infracción no detiene el proceso de desalojo.
rules.quoted_span: The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources must be delivered at the same time as the Notice to Quit.
rules.effective_date_quote: The HSNA becomes effective on November 6, 2020.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all landlords/foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in Boston.
rules.exemptions: Residences in hospitals, skilled nursing or health facilities, and in non-profit facilities whose primary purpose is short-term substance-abuse treatment, assistance or therapy.
rules.penalty: Warning for first offense; $300 per day for second and subsequent offenses (enforced by Inspectional Services Department).
rules.key_value: Notice delivered with Notice to Quit; copy to Office of Housing Stability
rules.caveat: Notice/procedural requirement only; does not restrict the grounds for eviction. Source is a tenant FAQ, section number given as Sec. 10-11.7.
